title: The chosen derived-adjunction counit on cochain representatives
statement: Let C and D be Grothendieck abelian categories in the chosen common successor hom universe. Assume C is braided closed monoidal with additive tensor and functorial flat resolutions. Let E:C→D and U:D→C be additive adjoint functors, with U exact and E preserving quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes. Write LE for the total left derived functor, b:LE⊣D(U) for the derived adjunction identified with exact restriction, and ad:L⊣D(U) for any chosen left adjoint. Let e:L≅LE be the uniqueness isomorphism. On a cochain complex P put dP=LE(qP inverse) followed by the left-derived counit and then q(EP), where q is the quotient-to-homotopy comparison. Then e at QP followed by dP is the transpose under ad of Q applied to the ordinary cochain unit followed by the inverse exact-functor localization comparison. Thus the chosen left adjoint has the same cochain counit.

proof.text: Apply the homotopy derived-unit identity derivedη_fac_app and identify the right derived functor with the levelwise exact U. The resulting identity says that the derived unit followed by U of the homotopy counit is the ordinary homotopy unit followed by the exact localization comparison.

Use naturality of q for the ordinary unit and of the derived unit for qP. Cancel the isomorphisms qP and the exact-functor comparison. This gives the same unit identity for dP on cochains, with both q factors explicitly retained.

Apply ad.homEquiv. The unit identity defining the uniqueness isomorphism e replaces the unit of ad by that of b, so the cochain identity just proved identifies both transposes. Injectivity of homEquiv proves the displayed counit formula.

theorem Adjunction.leftDerivedCochainCounit {L : DerivedCategory C ⥤ DerivedCategory D}
    (adj : E ⊣ U) (ad : L ⊣ U.mapDerivedCategory) (X : CochainComplex C ℤ) :
    let b := adj.derivedAdjunction.ofNatIsoRight U.rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory
    let e := ad.leftAdjointUniq b
    let q₀ := (DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso C).app X
    let q₁ := (DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso D).app
      ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj X)
    let ε := E.leftDerivedFunctorCounit.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj X)
    e.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj X) ≫
        E.leftDerivedFunctor.map q₀.inv ≫ ε ≫ q₁.hom =
      (ad.homEquiv _ _).symm
        (DerivedCategory.Q.map ((adj.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).unit.app X) ≫
          U.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj X))
